build_quasi_dense_tracker: build a QuasiDenseTracker instance with custom init_score_thr, obj_score_thr, and match_metric parameters for MOT tracking
track_objects_with_quasi_dense: run the QuasiDenseTracker track method to associate detections across frames using bisoftmax, softmax, or cosine matching
reset_tracker_buffer: call the reset method on QuasiDenseTracker to clear all tracks, backdrops, and track counters
update_tracks_with_embeddings: update existing tracklets and initialize new tracks by calling update with ids, bboxes, embeds, labels, scores, and frame_id
get_tracker_memory: access the memo property of QuasiDenseTracker to retrieve memo_bboxes, memo_labels, memo_embeds, memo_ids, and memo_vs tensors
